## Overview

The Balance Explorer combines several of the legacy rollup viewers:

- Daily Location Rollups
- Monthly Location Rollups
- NGL Balance
- Recovery Analysis Viewer

<div class="procedure">

To access the Balance Explorer:

Go to **Open** \> **Balance Explorer**.

<br/>![](data:image/png;base64,)

</div>

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Screen Configuration</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Screen Configuration">

Upon initially opening the Balance Explorer, the default layout is as follows:

| Open by Default   | Collapsed or Hidden by Default |
|-------------------|--------------------------------|
| Location Explorer | Date Selector                  |
| L&U Viewer        | Location Rollup Queue          |
| Member Viewer     |                                |

The L&U Viewer and Member Viewer panels can be expanded, hidden, moved, dragged out of the Balance Explorer window. Once hidden, you can reopen the panels from the Panel drop-down at the top of the screen.

The Location Explorer, L&U Viewer, and Member Viewer can be pinned and collapsed to the side of Balance Explorer.

</div>
